'''Elz Organa''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], Elz Organa started a crusade to free [[House of Organa/Legends|Organa]] citizens captured by [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] near the [[House Syrush (estate)|House Syrush estate]] and succeeded thanks to a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]].

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
